room: a bathroom and living room with a long backlit mirror over a stone vanity, a white clawfoot bathtub, a glass shower, a slatted wooden screen, a pink sofa, a slatted wooden bench and a round wooden table by a tall window

scenes.name: P2_bench_sit
scenes.action: sitting on the slatted wooden bench with her hands resting on her thighs
scenes.anchor: the bench seat reaches just below her knees

scenes.name: P4_table_stand
scenes.action: standing by the round wooden table near the window, her body turned three-quarters to the side, her arms relaxed
scenes.anchor: the round table reaches her upper thigh

scenes.name: P5_back_stand
scenes.action: standing with her back to the camera, facing the tall window, her head turned slightly to the side
scenes.anchor: the slatted wooden screen is taller than she is

scenes.name: P6_crouch
scenes.action: crouching low on the wooden floor by the round table, her forearms resting on her knees
scenes.anchor: crouched, her head is level with the top of the sofa backrest

scenes.name: P8_hand_face
scenes.action: standing next to the clawfoot bathtub, her right hand touching her right cheek, her left arm hanging relaxed at her side
scenes.anchor: the rim of the bathtub reaches her upper thigh

scenes.name: P9_hip_one
scenes.action: standing next to the clawfoot bathtub with only her left hand on her hip, her right arm hanging straight down at her side
scenes.anchor: the rim of the bathtub reaches her upper thigh

scenes.name: P10_phone
scenes.action: standing next to the clawfoot bathtub, looking at a smartphone she holds in her right hand in front of her chest, her left arm hanging relaxed
scenes.anchor: the rim of the bathtub reaches her upper thigh

props.desc: a black smartphone held in her right hand
